objective: Phase 3 (25.8): the current system (rules, validator, standard plan, no model) and Claude as the agent with the same tools and validator, on the same blind studied samples, step by step against the planted truth (the target and the leak columns of the R&D's own solution), with each lane's holdout number, cost and time; and Claude's expert record, version by version, against the system's answers. Read with dclab_core.twin.effectiveness (twin_rule_v1).
rule: A measurement on these samples with these caps and this model: where each arm was right on the planted truth, and what it cost. It is not a claim about other problems or about production readiness; a step below the rule's minimum of judged cases stays undecided.
